evidence.locator: Python 3.12.13 os.fsync, os.replace, and tempfile.mkstemp documentation
evidence.note: os.fsync is available on Unix and Windows after buffered flush; os.replace supports cross-platform overwrite and is atomic when successful; mkstemp securely creates a non-inherited temporary file and accepts an explicit directory.

criteria.note: The design will create the temporary anchor in the destination directory, flush and fsync bytes, close it, then replace the sibling endpoint. It will not claim directory-entry durability or cross-filesystem replacement.

evidence.note: The planned anchor contains only schema, trace filename, event count, final event digest, and its own unkeyed digest. It adds no personal data, secret, signing material, service, model, package, real trace, or external destination.

criteria.note: A sibling unkeyed anchor detects mismatched endpoints but cannot authenticate a writer who can recompute both files.
